A '''''Munificent''-class star frigate''' was created at the [[Gwori shipyards]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] stole the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] to help them transport the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] workers in the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] off-world during a [[Battle of Gwori|battle on Gwori]].

The frigate was not fitted with armaments, so the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were unable to fight through the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] around the planet. They were forced to play safe; when traffic control ordered them to pass through the [[Scan gate|scanning station]], they obeyed. Unfortunately [[Overseer]] [[Juhm]], in charge of the operations on Gwori, ordered the station to activate its radiation beam, which would kill everyone on board the frigate. However, Jedi Masters [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] opened fire on the station from their [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|interceptors]], destroying it and allowing the frigate to pass safely through. Since their [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive rings]] had been destroyed, Koon and Tiin boarded the frigate, which then flew safely to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
